title: kOA Sovereignty Bundle Schema
description: Canonical schema for a complete, portable, independently verifiable tenant or organization export that preserves data, governance, Kristal artifacts, rights, evidence, trust handover, and clean-restore instructions. A conforming bundle is an integrity-protected supply-chain artifact; its inventory digests do not create a general per-file hash requirement for ordinary Markdown outside the bundle.

schema_version.description: Version of this Sovereignty Bundle manifest contract.
